title: Fix pre-existing @flash/swf parse-back test failure: DoAction body starts with 0x88 (ActionConstantPool) instead of expected 0x96 (ActionPush)
description: parse-back.test.ts assertion 'DoAction: gotoAndPlay(2) script → body first byte is ActionPush (0x96)' fails: expected 150 (0x96=ActionPush), got 136 (0x88=ActionConstantPool). This may be an expected outcome of task 0898 (ActionConstantPool auto-emit) where the compiler now correctly emits a constant pool for scripts with multiple string constants. If so, update the test expectation. If not, investigate why the first byte is ActionConstantPool instead of ActionPush for a simple gotoAndPlay(2) call.
